$comment: Authorization posture for every app/api route handler. Enforced by
rules, and docs/manager/quality/QUALITY_GATE.md for how it fits the gate).
A route belongs here only if it does NOT reach an authorization helper.
Routes that do are detected automatically and must not be listed — a
redundant entry is a hard failure, so this file cannot rot into a blanket
publicRoutes   = intentionally unauthenticated. Requires a reason.
knownViolations = missing or unreviewed authorization, tracked for a fix.
Capped by maxKnownViolations so the list can only shrink.

publicRoutes.reason: The staff login endpoint itself — it establishes the session, so it cannot require one. Its own defect (hardcoded credentials) is tracked separately in ROADMAP #23; this entry declares only that being unauthenticated is correct here.
Clears the admin-token cookie. Safe to call unauthenticated: the worst outcome is that a caller logs themselves out.
Static discovery document describing what the agent API offers. Contains no tenant data and no per-caller information.
Liveness probe. Returns service status only, and is deliberately callable without credentials so uptime monitoring works.

Public NotiBot chat surface on the marketing site. Reads published articles only. NOTE: unauthenticated and calls a paid LLM, so it needs rate limiting — see knownViolations rationale for app/api/ai/explain/route.ts.
Public newsletter opt-in and opt-out by email address. Unauthenticated by design; abuse is bounded by the double opt-in flow rather than by a session.
Public news listing. Serves only published articles and is the primary read path for anonymous visitors.
Public single-article read. Serves only published articles to anonymous visitors.
Public category listing. Serves only published articles to anonymous visitors.
Public ranked feed for the home page. Ranking inputs are aggregate, not per-user.
Public trending list computed from aggregate engagement counters. No per-user data is read or returned.
Public paste-a-link summariser used from the landing page. NOTE: unauthenticated and LLM-backed, so it shares the rate-limiting concern recorded against app/api/ai/explain/route.ts.
Public read-through of curated Reddit content. SSRF hardening and the blank-limit fix landed in PRs #106 and #108.
Public read of the configured social links shown in the site footer. Returns published configuration only.
Public aggregate site counters (article totals, category counts). No per-user rows are read.

knownViolations.reason: IDOR: GET returns any user's email and full read history for a client-supplied ?userId, and PUT writes any user's profile and preferences. Confirmed live defect; the fix is owned by a separate task.
IDOR: writes a reaction on behalf of any client-supplied userId with only a presence check. Confirmed live defect; the fix is owned by a separate task.
IDOR: saves articles for, and lists the saved articles of, any client-supplied userId. Confirmed live defect; the fix is owned by a separate task.
IDOR: reads and advances any client-supplied userId's streak, which is gamification state a caller should not be able to inflate for themselves or reset for others.

Accepts analytics events carrying a caller-supplied userId with no verification, so event history can be attributed to arbitrary users. Lower impact than the read-path IDORs but the same missing-check class.
Returns experiment assignment for a caller-supplied userId. Discloses which variant another user is in; needs a posture decision from 01-cto rather than an assumed-public label.
Reads and mutates share-link records that carry a userId. Public resolution of a share code is legitimate, but the mutating path has not been reviewed for who may call it.
Unauthenticated write path recording share visits. Plausibly public by design, but it is an unauthenticated insert with no rate limit and has not been formally reviewed.

Unauthenticated endpoint that calls a paid LLM provider with caller-supplied text. No auth and no rate limit means an anonymous caller can drive spend; needs either a session check or a quota before it can be declared public.
